data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic elements dal- (given) and borka (bright, renowned), Daliborka means 'God's gift' or 'God's renowned one'. The name Daliborka carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Daliborka usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
